arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && cat > build.py <<'EOF'
"""Offline standard-library-only Rust build driver.

All build products go into the directory named by BUILD_DIR (supplied by
main.py, unique per request) so that the frozen submission directory is never
written to and concurrent requests cannot collide on the same artefacts.
"""
import os,pathlib,subprocess
base=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
default=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('TMPDIR','/workspace/tmp'))/'unit-merge-build'
out=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('BUILD_DIR') or str(default))
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy();env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']='/opt/rust/lib'
flags=['/opt/rust/bin/rustc','--edition=2021','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl','-C','opt-level=2','-C','codegen-units=1','-A','warnings']
subprocess.run(flags+['--crate-name','rust_unit_merge','--crate-type','rlib',str(base/'src/lib.rs'),'-o',str(out/'librust_unit_merge.rlib')],env=env,check=True)
subprocess.run(flags+['--crate-name','rust_unit_merge_cli','-C','link-arg=--threads=2','-C','linker=/opt/rust/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rust-lld',str(base/'src/main.rs'),'--extern','rust_unit_merge='+str(out/'librust_unit_merge.rlib'),'-o',str(out/'engine')],env=env,check=True)
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='/workspace/submission/main.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = """    base=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    subprocess.run(['sh',str(base/'build.sh')],check=True)
    binary=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('TMPDIR','/workspace/tmp'))/'unit-merge-build/engine'
    result=subprocess.run([str(binary)],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
"""
new = """    base=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    work=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('TMPDIR','/workspace/tmp'))/('unit-merge-build-'+str(os.getpid()))
    binary=work/'engine'
    try:
        env=os.environ.copy();env['BUILD_DIR']=str(work)
        subprocess.run(['sh',str(base/'build.sh')],check=True,env=env)
        result=subprocess.run([str(binary)],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(work,ignore_errors=True)
"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('import json, math, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys','import json, math, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
head -3 main.py; tail -18 main.py; cd /workspace && python3 dev/mini_check.py
